faq.q: How much does Shapiro, Cohen & Basinger, Trial Lawyers charge?
faq.a: Shapiro, Cohen & Basinger, Trial Lawyers publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.a: Yes. Shapiro, Cohen & Basinger, Trial Lawyers publishes a free initial consultation. It publishes material in Spanish.
